[LEARN]
insight: Inter-Review creating exact duplicate tasks - same "No tests detected" suggestion generated multiple times, suggesting no deduplication at source
context: When review findings are created without checking for existing identical tasks
[/LEARN]

[LEARN]
insight: Backlog stable at 133 PENDING but not decreasing - consumption rate roughly equals generation rate
context: System at equilibrium but elevated backlog indicates over-generation of low-value tasks
[/LEARN]

[ISSUE]
title: Inter-Review has no deduplication when creating tasks - same suggestion generated repeatedly type: bug severity: high
[/ISSUE]

[PROMPT_UPDATE]
insight: Before creating Inter-Review tasks, check if identical/similar task already exists in PENDING state to avoid duplicate work
context: When implementing Inter-Review task creation logic
[/PROMPT_UPDATE]
